moves.name: Roman Wilson
moves.text: Drop candidate: Roman Wilson (PIT WR) - RotoWire: "Expected to miss time" (Oct 11); out Weeks 7-9, back about Week 10 (Week 9 is his bye); ~9.6 a game when healthy. No IR slot is left, so holding him costs a roster seat while he is out. The cheapest other bench seat to free instead: George Holani (SEA RB), worth ~7 pts to the best lineup through Week 17. Dom's call - never an order.
